annotations.title: Send a demo or offer request

description: Sends a demo, trial or offer request to the PLCGateway team by e-mail; they answer the user directly. Ask the user for their name and e-mail address; company, phone, the product they are interested in and a short description of their machines and goals are optional but help. Never invent, guess or reuse contact details the user did not give for this request. Before calling, show the user exactly what will be sent and ask for permission; set user_confirmed to true only after they explicitly agreed. Their details are used only to answer the request (privacy notice: https://plcgateway.com/privacy).

language.description: Answer language: the user's language if available.

message.description: Machines, controllers, number of computers, goals, preferred time for a call.

user_confirmed.description: true only after the user has seen these details and agreed to send them.

name: request_demo
